author: Ethan63021
body: Recently I was playing on Avicus when I needed help figuring out why I couldn't join a game. I eventually asked a moderator why I couldn't join and when I still didn't understand, he became increasingly rude and eventually began swearing. This really bothered me as I was playing and would like if you could ban him from my once favorite server. When I told him to be more nice and I reported him, he temp-banned me for 'abusing a report.' :(

title: Please Ban This Mod: DeliciousShoesHD

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hello Ethan.

Please send all staff complaints to support@avicus.net.

For your TempBan, it was justified as You have abused /report a bunch of times (looking at your infraction history) and we do not allow that. Only use /report on specific cases when players break rules

Regards,
Edans
